retrieved_sources.title: Supported OS & Kernel Combinations - PipelineHub CI/CD Build
retrieved_sources.text:
Overview
--------

This document outlines the current status and results of supported operating system (OS) and kernel combinations for image builds in PipelineHub CI/CD pipelines. As PipelineHub' support expands to additional distributions and kernel variants, this page may serve as a central reference for compatibility notes and validations. 

Background
----------

Production builds primarily take place using Enterprise Linux 8 (aka EnterpriseLinux8) built on VMs running EnterpriseLinux8 UEK 7 (Unbreakable Enterprise Kernel). To ensure broad compatibility and provide flexibility, PipelineHub has begun evaluating builds across multiple Enterprise Linux versions, EnterpriseLinux8 & EnterpriseLinux9, using VMs running differing EnterpriseLinux8 UEK versions (UEK6, UEK7).

Supported CI/CD Combinations
----------------------------

The following summarizes a set of tests executed to verify compatibility and extend support for additional configurations.  
 

| Base Image OS | Build Kernel | Compile | Docker Creation | Publish | Support | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EnterpriseLinux8 | OL8u10 UEK7 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported | Baseline |
| EnterpriseLinux8 | OL8u6 UEK6 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported |  |
| EnterpriseLinux9 | OL8u10 UEK7 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported |  |
| EnterpriseLinux9 | OL8u6 UEK6 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported |  |

**NOTE** : If the repo created has ARM bits, by default template created will also be ARM Enabled. To just create a X86 template, you will have to deselect "Enabled ARM64" checkbox in the Advanced Parameters section. Also if you use "Create Repo and Template" option, there is no way to unselect ARM, so if your IntegrationBuild is ARM enabled, your repo and template will also be ARM enabled.

### OVM Script Directory can be passed while template creation

### EnterpriseLinux8 images for BusinessApp Template

PipelineHub now support creation of starter and deploymenttemplate templates using EnterpriseLinux8 images.

User should be able to create template on EnterpriseLinux8 VMs now by selecting the check box "EnterpriseLinux8" on the UI.

EnterpriseLinux8 enabled Repo is a pre-requisite  so the parameters - "-os_flvr enterpriselinux86_x64" can be passed will be delivered as a part of September Sprint.

### No default MLR on Template Creation

There will be no MLR information displayed on template creation page. 

**Same is applicable for create Repo and Template UI**

### IdentityService Support for Template Creation

PipelineHub UI now provide a flag to support IdentityService enablement during "Create Template" and "Create Repo & template" submissions. 

### Capability to default IdentityService for Template flow

* PipelineHub can set the default as IdentityService when EnvironmentService is ready to default in PreProduction (Controlled by a flag within PIPELINEHUB. Currently set to false; Will be turned to true once EnvironmentService defaults IdentityService in PreProduction)
* This is supported for creation of Template and  Template based Provisioning.

Overview
========

SecurityScan Scans are able to be run on both services and applications. For services, one may be triggered on a service version or an individual snapshot. For applications, SecurityScan Scan can only be triggered at the application version level.

Services
========

Trigger on Snapshot
-------------------

### Prerequisites

To trigger a SecurityScan Scan on a service snapshot, there are a few requirements:

1. **All project components must be registered in the project's Source Repo config**
